Definition: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
BiblicalUsage: The word is a family, a clan, a kindred, and it is the way God counts His people. The nations were divided after their families, the promise was that in Abraham all the families of the earth would be blessed, and Israel was numbered and judged family by family.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the family is God's unit. He blesses families, He numbers families, and He judges families, because the promise runs through the house, not only the man.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
